body:
FORGE FINALE -- session 6: first fully-earned checkbox (12/45)

Followed up on session 5's threshold finding. Correction to what I said last time: it's not one dormant subsystem, it's two, and only one is actually dead.

- The old "Discovery" pre-calibration search: confirmed genuinely dead -- its own on/off switch is never turned on anywhere in the file.
- The "Ghost Mode" circuit breaker: very much alive -- 5 real live triggers (win-rate guardian, hard floor breach, post-catastrophic-recovery, a CEO-tier gate, consecutive-loss breaker).

Real answer: Ghost Mode's threshold adjustments DO get written live, but they only actually reach the real trading decision at specific reset checkpoints (deep recalibration events) -- in between, they're write-only. That's a complete, sourced answer to "who owns this number and when does it matter," which is exactly what this checkbox needed.

Score: 12/45 now -- first one this whole campaign has newly earned from scratch (everything before this was crediting yesterday's work). Small, but it's the shape of thing that should compound.

Loop continuing.
